observations.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'packs', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'slug',p.slug,'version_id',v.id,'version',v.version_number,'content_status',v.content_status,
   'validation_label',v.validation_label,'published_at',v.published_at,'stored_hash',v.content_hash,
   'recomputed_hash',public.scp_interview_pack_content_hash(v.id),
   'reviews',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('gate',r.gate,'decision',r.decision,'hash',r.content_hash_at_review)), '[]') FROM public.scp_interview_pack_reviews r WHERE r.pack_version_id=v.id),
   'competencies',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'name_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(c.name_en),'') IS NULL),'definition_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(c.definition_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_pack_competencies c WHERE c.pack_version_id=v.id),
   'questions',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'prompt_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(q.prompt_en),'') IS NULL),'types',jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code',q.code,'type',q.question_type) ORDER BY q.display_order)) FROM public.scp_interview_core_questions q WHERE q.pack_version_id=v.id),
   'probes',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'wording_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(a.wording_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_approved_probes a WHERE a.pack_version_id=v.id),
   'dimensions',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'label_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(d.label_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_evidence_dimensions d JOIN public.scp_interview_core_questions q ON q.id=d.question_id WHERE q.pack_version_id=v.id),
   'anchors',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'label_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(a.label_en),'') IS NULL),'anchor_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(a.anchor_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_rating_anchors a LEFT JOIN public.scp_interview_core_questions q ON q.id=a.question_id LEFT JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_competencies c ON c.id=a.pack_competency_id WHERE coalesce(q.pack_version_id,c.pack_version_id)=v.id),
   'prohibitions',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'statement_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(a.statement_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_prohibited_areas a WHERE a.pack_version_id=v.id)
 ) ORDER BY p.slug,v.version_number) FROM public.scp_interview_packs p JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_versions v ON v.pack_id=p.id WHERE p.slug IN('vaktare-se','security-manager-se')),
 'methods',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'slug',m.slug,'version',m.version_number,'state',m.approval_state,'approved_at',m.approved_at,
 'practices',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'statement_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(x.statement_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_method_practices x WHERE x.method_id=m.id),
 'conduct_steps',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'label_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(x.label_en),'') IS NULL),'guidance_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(x.guidance_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_conduct_steps x WHERE x.method_id=m.id),
 'conduct_guidance',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'statement_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(x.statement_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_conduct_guidance x WHERE x.method_id=m.id),
 'conduct_prohibitions',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'statement_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(x.statement_en),'') IS NULL)) FROM public.scp_interview_conduct_prohibitions x WHERE x.method_id=m.id)
 ) ORDER BY m.slug,m.version_number) FROM public.scp_interview_methods m),
 'unpaired_sv_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.table_name,'column',c.column_name) ORDER BY c.table_name,c.ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='public' AND c.table_name IN('scp_interview_pack_versions','scp_interview_pack_competencies','scp_interview_core_questions','scp_interview_approved_probes','scp_interview_evidence_dimensions','scp_interview_rating_anchors','scp_interview_verification_rules','scp_interview_prohibited_areas','scp_trust_stages','scp_trust_prohibitions') AND c.column_name LIKE '%_sv' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns e WHERE e.table_schema=c.table_schema AND e.table_name=c.table_name AND e.column_name=regexp_replace(c.column_name,'_sv$','_en')))
) AS content_review

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at', now(), 'packs', (
 SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slug',p.slug,'name_en_missing',CASE WHEN nullif(btrim(p.name_en),'') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
 'summary_sv_nonblank',(CASE WHEN nullif(btrim(v.summary_sv),'') IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),
 'sv_only_fields',jsonb_build_object(
 'observable_indicators_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_pack_competencies c WHERE c.pack_version_id=v.id AND cardinality(c.observable_indicators_sv)>0),
 'evidence_source_note_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_core_questions c WHERE c.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(c.evidence_source_note_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'description_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_evidence_dimensions d JOIN public.scp_interview_core_questions q ON q.id=d.question_id WHERE q.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(d.description_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'mapping_rationale_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_pack_competency_map m JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_competencies c ON c.id=m.pack_competency_id WHERE c.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(m.rationale_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'verification_rule_requirement_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_verification_rules r WHERE r.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(r.requirement_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'verification_rule_interview_action_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_verification_rules r WHERE r.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(r.interview_action_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'verification_rule_subsequent_verification_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_verification_rules r WHERE r.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(r.subsequent_verification_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'verification_rule_passport_boundary_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_verification_rules r WHERE r.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(r.passport_boundary_sv),'') IS NOT NULL),
 'prohibition_rationale_sv',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.scp_interview_prohibited_areas r WHERE r.pack_version_id=v.id AND nullif(btrim(r.rationale_sv),'') IS NOT NULL)
 )
 ) ORDER BY p.slug) FROM public.scp_interview_packs p JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_versions v ON v.pack_id=p.id WHERE p.slug IN('vaktare-se','security-manager-se')),
 'trust',(SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'stage_rows',count(*),
 'name_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(s.name_en),'') IS NULL),
 'purpose_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(s.purpose_en),'') IS NULL),
 'human_responsibility_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(s.human_responsibility_en),'') IS NULL),
 'output_sv_nonblank',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(s.output_sv),'') IS NOT NULL)
 ) FROM public.scp_trust_stages s JOIN public.scp_interview_methods m ON m.id=s.method_id WHERE m.slug='cqrity-trust' AND m.version_number=1),
 'unpaired_sv_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.table_name,'column',c.column_name) ORDER BY c.table_name,c.ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='public'
 AND c.table_name IN('scp_interview_pack_competency_map','scp_interview_core_questions','scp_interview_evidence_dimensions','scp_interview_pack_competencies','scp_interview_pack_versions','scp_interview_prohibited_areas','scp_interview_verification_rules','scp_trust_stages','scp_trust_stage_prohibitions')
 AND right(c.column_name,3)='_sv' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns e WHERE e.table_schema=c.table_schema AND e.table_name=c.table_name AND e.column_name=regexp_replace(c.column_name,'_sv$','_en'))),
 'current_content_triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',n.nspname||'.'||t.relname,'trigger',g.tgname,'function',p.proname) ORDER BY t.relname,g.tgname)
 FROM pg_trigger g JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid=g.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=g.tgfoid
 WHERE NOT g.tgisinternal AND n.nspname='public' AND t.relname IN('scp_interview_methods','scp_interview_method_practices','scp_interview_conduct_steps','scp_interview_conduct_guidance','scp_interview_conduct_prohibitions','scp_trust_stages','scp_trust_stage_prohibitions','scp_interview_pack_versions','scp_interview_core_questions')),
 'method_write_policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies p WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN('scp_interview_methods','scp_interview_method_practices') AND cmd IN('INSERT','UPDATE','ALL'))
) AS release_details

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'observed_at',now(),
'trust_prohibitions',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'statement_en_missing',count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(p.statement_en),'') IS NULL))
 FROM public.scp_trust_stage_prohibitions p JOIN public.scp_trust_stages s ON s.id=p.stage_id JOIN public.scp_interview_methods m ON m.id=s.method_id WHERE m.slug='cqrity-trust' AND m.version_number=1),
'method_text_columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('column',column_name,'type',data_type) ORDER BY ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='scp_interview_methods' AND data_type IN('text','ARRAY')),
'method_summary',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slug',m.slug,'name',m.name,'version',m.version_number,'supported_behaviours',m.supported_behaviours,'product_implementation',m.product_implementation) ORDER BY m.slug) FROM public.scp_interview_methods m),
'pack_mapping_states',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('slug',p.slug,'rows',z.rows,'provisional',z.provisional,'confirmed',z.confirmed) ORDER BY p.slug) FROM public.scp_interview_packs p JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_versions v ON v.pack_id=p.id CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cm.mapping_state='provisional') provisional,count(*) FILTER(WHERE cm.mapping_state='confirmed') confirmed FROM public.scp_interview_pack_competency_map cm JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_competencies c ON c.id=cm.pack_competency_id WHERE c.pack_version_id=v.id)z WHERE p.slug IN('vaktare-se','security-manager-se'))
) AS method_details

method_summary.name: CQrity TRUST Interview Method
supported_behaviours: Samma versionspinnade kärnfrågor i samma ordning för alla kandidater i samma roll
Autonomistödjande, accepterande, anpassad, empatisk och evokativ intervjuarstil
Källbunden AI-förberedelse och AI-evidensförslag med citat
Mänsklig bekräftelse av varje evidens innan bedömning
method_summary.product_implementation: Fem stage definitions med tillåtna AI-uppgifter, mänskliga gates, förbjudna tolkningar och forskningsspårbarhet. Stegen härleds ur befintligt case-tillstånd; ingen andra statuskolumn införs.

method_summary.name: Evidence-oriented probing
supported_behaviours: Probe against a named evidence dimension
method_summary.product_implementation: Approved probes selected from the pinned pack, probe_usages recording what was actually asked, and a bounded contextual clarification path.

method_summary.name: ORBIT-informed interviewer conduct
method_summary.product_implementation: Stage-scoped interviewer guidance rendered in the workspace, permitted-probe purposes, and the process_reflection field which is about the interviewer.

method_summary.name: PEACE (recruitment adaptation)
supported_behaviours: Explain the process and the AI role
Read the facts back for correction
Evaluate individually against anchors after the account
method_summary.product_implementation: The session state machine (planning, engage_explain, account, closure, evaluation), the standardised opening, the read-back closure with a candidate_correction field, and interviewer self-evaluation at the end.

method_summary.name: Prohibited interviewing practice
method_summary.product_implementation: Prohibited areas from the pinned pack rendered as workspace warnings, and a policy validator that rejects AI output attempting any of them.

method_summary.name: Structured behavioural interviewing
supported_behaviours: Past behaviour described by the candidate
Rating against described behaviour, not impression
method_summary.product_implementation: Q1-Q8 pinned from the pack version, rendered verbatim, with per-question anchors 0-4 and no aggregation anywhere.

observations.query: SELECT p.slug,v.version_number,v.pilot_availability,v.content_status,public.scp_iv_open_pilot_available(v.id) open_pilot_available FROM public.scp_interview_packs p JOIN public.scp_interview_pack_versions v ON v.pack_id=p.id WHERE p.slug IN('vaktare-se','security-manager-se') ORDER BY p.slug

SELECT now() observed_at,(SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) migration_count,(SELECT max(version) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) migration_frontier,to_regprocedure('public.scp_iv_case_content_manifest(uuid)') foundation_manifest_rpc
